lead: A neighbourhood with one of the strongest community networks in Barcelona and festivals run by its residents.
text: La Prosperitat has a very active community life, with a neighbourhood centre, a youth centre, a senior citizens' centre, play centres and play areas, and festivals organised by its own groups. Every July, the central square hosts Prospe Beach. In 2026 it opened a public space of about 5,000 m² next to the Torre Júlia, funded with 2.9 million euros from the Pla de Barris, and a new cultural facility has been approved in the former Ideal Flor factory, with a library, an auditorium and a gym, with a planned budget of about 37.5 million euros.

It is a compact neighbourhood, of 0.59 km² and 28,174 inhabitants, with the Via Júlia as its shopping axis and the centre of neighbourhood life. Its sale price, 3,159 €/m², is below that of Porta and Vilapicina. If you are selling, the average sale price is 7% above the Nou Barris average. Within the neighbourhood, the price of each flat depends on its condition, its floor and its building, so it is best to compare it with nearby sales rather than with the district average. If you are buying, an 80 m² flat costs about 253,000 € on average, and this is one of the most expensive neighbourhoods in Nou Barris (3rd of 13 by price). If you are investing, the average rent (819 €/month) is in line with the district; before deciding, it is worth studying each deal with real figures for purchase, renovation and rental income.
housing: Blocks of flats from the second half of the 20th century, on densely populated streets.
